arguments.body:
# Implementation checklist

- [ ] Keep the event contract thin. Accept only `deploy_started`, `deploy_completed`, `owner_changed`, `incident_opened`, and `incident_resolved` for v0.
- [ ] Require every event to carry `event_id`, `service_id`, `observed_at`, `collected_at`, `source_system`, `source_ref`, `provenance`, `permission_scope`, `summary`, and a bounded typed payload.
- [ ] Validate required provenance and permission scope at ingestion; reject or keep incomplete facts out of the rendered surface rather than filling gaps with inference.
- [ ] Store incoming facts append-only. Build a derived read model for the UI; do not make the UI join source records or reconstruct hidden transitions.
- [ ] Keep status values to the agreed small, stable enum. Do not add statuses or reinterpretations without an explicit contract change.
- [ ] Render only permission-safe summaries. Expose underlying details only through a permissioned source pointer when the viewer already has access; otherwise show the bounded unavailable state.
- [ ] Show deploy movement, recorded-provenance ownership changes, and permission-safe incident-load summaries only. Omit ownership without recorded provenance.
- [ ] Keep the UI from inferring causal links, hidden state transitions, or code movement. Do not add query-volume deltas, code-movement inference, unpermissioned status chatter, or raw incident bodies.
- [ ] Verify with contract and UI tests: required envelope fields; append-only behavior; allowed event types; provenance/permission enforcement; read-model rendering; no hidden-state inference; and excluded-signal/data leakage checks.
- [ ] Treat any new event type, field, status, source, or UI interpretation as a boundary change requiring explicit review—not an implementation-only extension.
